item.title: Idaho Medical Cannabis Advocates Surpass 45K Signatures
item.description: Medical cannabis advocates in Idaho have gathered more than 45,000 signatures seeking to get the issue on November ballots. The proposed constitutional amendment seeks to allow the use of medical cannabis for qualifying patients with conditions including cancer, AIDS, Crohn’s disease, epilepsy, multiple sclerosis, Alzheimer’s and post-traumatic stress disorder.
